player_prompt.intro:
Miu riasengnge Sokoban. Miu ana'guru, na miu naribawangngiwiwiwiwi katto kasiwiwi boxe ri target.
        Manengngi miu ri samping boxe, miu naripasangnge boxe ri arah nu.
        Miu tena naripasangnge boxe ri tampo' wall, na miu tena naritarik boxe.
        Ri papan, objek riwakktuangnge: 
        - Ana'guru (iu) nampaknge ri 'P' 
        - Tampo' wall riwakktuangnge ri '#' 
        - Boxe riwakktuangnge ri 'X' 
        - Sasaran kosong riwakktuangnge ri 'O'
        - Boxe ri sasaran riwakktuangnge ri '√'
        Miu naripakai [w] ri aje', [a] ri kiri, [s] ri bajo, na [d] ri kanan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Katto naripasangnge tena sesuai ri format nu. Pakai [up], [down], [left], [right] atau [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Iyyaro appittangnge de'na ulle toni ripajokkai.
invalid_move.invalid_position: Lompona de'na ulle - dee nawedding ri pallawangeng onrong.

game_message.pushed_prefix: Nappa natorong seddi kotak riwettue ro.

outcome.turn_limit: Watang giliranna pura ri cappu. Iko de' na runtui passalaingenge.
